verses.en: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
verses.pt: Celebrai com júbilo ao Senhor, todos os habitantes da terra.
verses.en_web: Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm of Praise.> Make a glad sound to the Lord, all the earth.

verses.en: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
verses.pt: Servi ao Senhor com alegria, e apresentai-vos a ele com cântico.
verses.en_web: Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
verses.en_bbe: Give worship to the Lord with joy; come before him with a song.

verses.en: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.pt: Sabei que o Senhor é Deus! Foi ele quem nos fez, e somos dele; somos o seu povo e ovelhas do seu pasto.
verses.en_web: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.en_bbe: Be certain that the Lord is God; it is he who has made us, and we are his; we are his people, and the sheep to whom he gives food.

verses.en: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
verses.pt: Entrai pelas suas portas com ação de graças, e em seus átrios com louvor; dai-lhe graças e bendizei o seu nome.
verses.en_web: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
verses.en_bbe: Come into his doors with joy, and into his house with praise; give him honour, blessing his name.

verses.en: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
verses.pt: Porque o Senhor é bom; a sua benignidade dura para sempre, e a sua fidelidade de geração em geração.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord is good, and his mercy is never-ending; his faith is unchanging through all generations.
